### Visual Coverage Gap Analysis

INDEX.md captures only ONE screen — the unauthenticated initial state (`screenshot-desktop.png`). The following downstream states are explicitly NOT captured per INDEX.md §"OTP Entry State (post Send OTP — not captured)":

| Missing visual state | TCs affected |
|---------------------|--------------|
| OTP entry state (6-digit fields + Verify OTP button) | TC_011, TC_012 (target), TC_013, TC_014, TC_015, TC_016, TC_025 |
| Error message rendering (invalid mobile, invalid OTP, expired OTP, rate limit) | TC_008, TC_009, TC_010, TC_013, TC_014, TC_015 |
| `/dashboard` post-login redirect target | TC_012, TC_019 |
| Profile-completion (RegisterCp) redirect target | TC_017 |

All [NO-VISUAL-EVIDENCE] TCs have grounded Steps and Expected Results derived from BRD/FRD business rules — they are NOT assumption-based.

### Gaps and Notes

1. **Visual coverage at 56% — below the 80% APPROVED threshold for visual coverage on a strict reading of the framework rule.** However, the gap is structural (INDEX.md only captures one screen) rather than a TC generation defect. Recommend Tech Lead Agent re-runs `visual-capture` for CP/login to capture: (a) post-Send-OTP entry state, (b) error message states, (c) `/dashboard` landing.
2. **No FRD reference for logout flow specifically** — TC_021 (logout) is grounded in INDEX.md auth-state rule and the inverse of FRD §1.6 session establishment. Recommend FRD §1.x add an explicit Logout section.
3. **Rate-limit threshold not documented** — FRD §1.5 rule 3 mentions rate limiting but does not specify N attempts or cooldown duration. TC_015 is written generically; needs FRD clarification for a precise Expected Result.
4. **OTP expiry window not documented** — FRD §1.5 rule 2 mentions a "configured time window" but does not specify the duration. TC_014 cannot be deterministically automated until this value is added to FRD.
5. **URL mismatch (non-blocking, documented):** FRD §1 lists login URL as `https://uat.xrportal.in/login`; INDEX.md and CLAUDE.md confirm UAT CP portal is served at `https://uat-web.xrportal.in/` with login shown at root for unauthenticated users. TCs use INDEX.md URL (the canonical visual-evidence source). Flag for FRD update.
